value.rationale: Birth age organizes dependence in homogeneous recursive trees, making extension under fitness heterogeneity a natural structural question. The counterexample shows that a single-sign-threshold principle fails already with strictly increasing weights at the smallest feasible tree order, while the universal formula lets one analyze any deterministic fitness profile. The counterexample is stable under small positive weight perturbations, so it is not an isolated equality or numerical artifact. It does not claim a general sign-pattern classification or large downstream theorem.
